reviewMethod: Visual inspection of all active portraits in labelled paired sheets, with full-size review of suspected defects; no automated anatomy score.
selection: Correct the user-reported Supply Commissioner pair and four other clear strained-neck or work-gaze mismatches. Preserve contextual command, teaching, conversation and navigation glances. Camera-facing portraits with coherent necks are recorded as optional refinements.

additionalFullSizeDecision.nearchus-common-female: Coherent head/neck with modest outward portrait gaze while handling a line; no strained-neck repair selected.
additionalFullSizeDecision.nearchus-rare-female: Pilot observing the horizon is role-appropriate; neck/shoulders support this moderate turn.
